About the The Bike Way / Omaha Velo Monday Shop Ride group ride

The weekly road ride of Omaha's race club, run out of The Bike Way. Fast, 20 mph and up, with regroups; riders are expected to know the route and get themselves home. No TT bikes. There is also a Saturday 9 am no-drop ride from Roast Coffeehouse in Aksarben, May through September.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
